issue.title: Fetch & upsert all API data
issue.body:
## Context

- Part of the mobile sync epic: #14
- Depends on: #15 

## Background
Core sync logic. Fetches all required data from the server in order and 
upserts into SQLite. Runs on every manual sync trigger.

## Tasks

### 1. Chapter assignments
- [ ] Call `GET /users/:userId/chapter-assignments` using `userId` from MMKV
- [x] Use `assignedChapters` array only — ignore `peerCheckChapters`
- [x] Upsert into `chapter_assignments`:

| Column | Source |
|--------|--------|
| `id` | `chapterAssignmentId` |
| `project_unit_id` | `projectUnitId` |
| `bible_id` | `bibleId` |
| `book_id` | `bookId` |
| `chapter_number` | `chapterNumber` |
| `assigned_user_id` | `assignedUserId` |
| `status` | `status` |
| `submitted_time` | `submittedTime` |
| `updated_at` | `updatedAt` |

### 2. Derive project_units
- [x] Collect distinct `projectUnitId` values from the assignments response
- [x] Upsert into `project_units` with `id` and `project_id` 
      (matched from projects already in SQLite)
- [x] No separate fetch needed

### 3. Bulk bible texts
- [x] After chapter assignments are written, collect all unique 
      `(bookId, chapterNumber)` pairs from `chapter_assignments`
- [x] Group by `bibleId` (a user may be assigned chapters across multiple bibles)
- [x] Skip the bulk call entirely if all `(bible_id, book_id, chapter_number)` 
      combos already exist in SQLite — avoids re-fetching on every sync
- [x] For each `bibleId`, call `POST /bibles/:bibleId/bulk-texts` with:
```json
{
  "chapters": [
    { "bookId": 40, "chapterNumber": 1 },
    { "bookId": 40, "chapterNumber": 2 }
  ]
}
```
- [x] Upsert into `bible_texts`:

| Column | Source |
|--------|--------|
| `id` | response `id` |
| `bible_id` | URL param `bibleId` |
| `book_id` | response `bookId` |
| `chapter_number` | response `chapterNumber` |
| `verse_number` | response `verseNumber` |
| `text` | response `text` |

Note: `bible_id`, `book_id`, and `chapter_number` must be injected 
manually when writing rows as they are not inside the `verses` array.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] After sync, `chapter_assignments`, `project_units` and `bible_texts` 
      are all populated
- [x] `project_units` rows are derived from assignments — no extra API call
- [ ] Bulk bible texts call is skipped if data already exists in SQLite
- [x] Re-running sync does not duplicate rows (upsert on `id`)
